hypothesis: The step-24 SFT painter can transfer the corrected paint-inspect-revise interface to real-photo references and improve over the unadapted base on recognizable structure and holistic visual quality.

scope.selection: Deterministic diverse sample from the existing 28 COCO development photos, selected before outputs.

runtime.bootstrap_fix: Installed tomli==2.2.1 before launch after minimal eval runtime dry-run exposed a missing TOML parser; both jobs use the corrected environment.

limitations: One sample perphoto/policy does not estimate best-of-k capability.
COCO is widely used; no unseen-pretraining claim.
Current evaluation defaults disable thinking; failure is not a claim that all prompting or planning configurations fail.

luna_low_revision_preferences.scope: All eleven base trajectories with valid first/final canvases; single-pass neutral A/B review.

luna_low_policy_preferences.scope: Only three comparable valid-canvas pairs; parent disagrees on sink/skier.

results.quality: Recognizable rough layouts on some base cases; not consistently high-quality painting. Step24 transfers poorly to the tested photos.

local_replay_manifest_note: Same frozen case records as node input; only model/label metadata corrected to actual served base/sft IDs.

interim_observations.base: Photo009 and599 first valid renders at turn2 after API/global-name failures. Parent visually inspected: recognizable layout but weak proportions, tone, opacity and detail.
interim_observations.sft: Completed photo009/127/599 emit repeated no-code planning sentences on all six turns; photo208 has a valid first canvas with coarse layout and oversimplified dinosaur.
interim_observations.preview_warning: Renderer writes diagnostic PNGs for invalid programs too. First preview canvases were initially described incorrectly as valid in commentary, corrected after receipts were read. Gallery uses only recorded valid canvases.

attempts.reason: API context exhaustion on fourth request for long photo programs after earlier successful valid paintings; not a complete six-turn ability test. Preserve earlier no-code failures and successful renders; rerun same frozen cases with larger operational envelope.

utilization.scope: All primary finite-run telemetry including rendering and idle tail; no trainer.

render_deadline_controls.scope: Post-hoc exact final-program replays, excluded from primary matched counts. No additional model generation. Renderer deadline180 rather than120 seconds.
render_deadline_controls.failed_operator_attempt: A 300-second request was rejected by the CLI before rendering; log/protocol preserved. Corrected to supported 180 seconds.

evidence_archive.verification: All 525 listed files and archive hash verified locally; four latest directory aliases recorded without materializing duplicate paths.

cost_actual_estimate.basis: Rental creation through verified absence at quoted $1.29/hour; includes bootstrap, interrupted attempt, primary evaluation, diagnostic renders and preservation. Not a final provider invoice.
